title.narrative: Harnessing forests and ecosystems for a climate-nature-people triple win (HARNESS)

description.narrative:
Harnessing forests and ecosystems for a climate-nature-people triple win (HARNESS) is a three-years project implemented in selected weredas of the Bale Eco region and South-West Ethiopia. The project’s long-term goal (impact) is to reduce and reverse deforestation and forest degradation in Ethiopia, contributing to the conservation of biodiversity, climate mitigation, inclusive green growth, and the improved livelihoods of forest-dependent communities.
The project has the following four interlinked Outcomes that contribute to the long-term goal; Outcome 1: Improved implementation of forest and land management policies and strategies Outcome 2: Improved knowledge base of the values of forest ecosystem services, and costs of deforestation and forest degradation Outcome 3: Improved rights and livelihoods of forest-dependent communities Outcome 4: Enhanced sustainable commodity production, trade, and finance mechanisms that support deforestation-free value chains in Ethiopia
